subject: Indonesia vendor tax setup — NPWP, PKP status and e-Faktur for PO activation
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Agus Saputra <agus@nuslog.co.id>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0700
Subject: Indonesia vendor onboarding — NPWP / PKP / e-Faktur requirements for PO activation

Hi Agus,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding with Redwood. Before we can activate purchase orders for PT Nusantara Logistics, our AP and tax teams need a few items from you to ensure invoices will validate against Indonesian tax rules and our PO system: 

- NPWP (company tax ID) scan / certificate (PDF)
- Confirmation whether PT Nusantara is PKP (Pengusaha Kena Pajak) and will issue e-Faktur (elektronik Faktur Pajak) for PPN (VAT)
- A sample e-Faktur XML/CSV or a PDF example of an issued invoice that includes the Faktur Pajak number (if available)
- Preferred invoice format and the billing email for e-invoice delivery
- Local bank details for PO / payment (bank name, account number, beneficiary)

Notes from our side: Redwood expects invoices to reference the PO number exactly as shown on the PO and to include the Faktur Pajak number when vendor is PKP. For now, treat PPN as a separate line (we can accept either VAT-inclusive or VAT-exclusive invoice but need the vendor to declare it clearly).

Can you attach the NPWP document and an example e-Faktur? If you have a company profile or WHT (PPh) statement that indicates whether withholding applies, please include that as well.

Thanks — attaching Mina (AP) and Vivek (Finance) to confirm internal handling.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sourcing Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (initial request)

From: Agus Saputra <agus@nuslog.co.id>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: PT Nusantara Logistics Accounts <billing@nuslog.co.id>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:45:00 +0700
Subject: Re: Indonesia vendor onboarding — NPWP / PKP / e-Faktur requirements for PO activation

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the checklist — please find the requested documents attached. PT Nusantara Logistics is registered as PKP and we issue e-Faktur for standard B2B services and freight. Key points: 

- NPWP: attached (npwp_certificate.pdf)
- PKP: our PKP status is active (contact person: Agus Saputra)
- e-Faktur: sample XML attached (efaktur_sample.xml) and a rendered PDF sample included (company_profile.pdf includes sample invoice pages)
- Withholding (PPh): typically not applied on international freight invoices billed to foreign principals when the vendor is domestic and issues e-Faktur; if Redwood instructs withholding, we can accommodate net/pay instructions but will need a written confirmation
- Billing email for e-invoices: billing@nuslog.co.id

We will issue invoices that separate PPN (11%) as a line item and reference your PO number and Faktur Pajak number. If your AP system requires any additional fields (tax code, GL mapping), please share and we will include them on our invoice.

Regards,
Agus Saputra
Head of Billing, PT Nusantara Logistics

Attachments: npwp_certificate.pdf (PDF), efaktur_sample.xml (XML), company_profile.pdf (PDF)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Agus Saputra <agus@nuslog.co.id>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:05:00 +0700
Subject: Fwd: Indonesia vendor onboarding — NPWP / PKP / e-Faktur requirements for PO activation

Mina / Vivek — forwarding PT Nusantara's docs. They confirm PKP and will issue e-Faktur with PPN at current rate (11%). Attached: NPWP and sample e-Faktur.

Questions for AP/Finance: 
- Does Redwood treat Indonesia vendor invoices as VAT chargeable with vendor-issued e-Faktur (i.e., no reverse charge)?
- Do we need to apply PPh withholding on these service / freight invoices when vendor is domestic and PKP? My read: not usually for domestic vendor issuing e-Faktur to a foreign buyer, but we should confirm.
- Once you confirm, I will activate the vendor in SAP and approve PO routing.

Quick summary of what vendor will send: invoice + e-Faktur number + NPWP + bank details.

Thanks,
Grace

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 03:03:00 +0700
Subject: RE: Indonesia vendor onboarding — NPWP / PKP / e-Faktur requirements for PO activation

Thanks Grace — reviewed the attachments. AP confirms vendor can be activated. Key items and instructions below for SAP/PO and payment: 

- Vendor activation: approve vendor record VND-98321 (internal). Please use legal name exactly as on NPWP.
- VAT handling: vendor is PKP and issues e-Faktur — treat PPN (11%) as vendor-charged VAT (do not move to reverse-charge). Invoices should include the Faktur Pajak number. AP will validate Faktur Pajak against NPWP.
- Withholding: For standard domestic freight/services we do NOT apply PPh 23 when the vendor issues e-Faktur labelled as PKP — no withholding required for this flow. If an invoice is billed as non-resident or the vendor indicates a foreign entity, AP/Tax will re-evaluate.
- PO setup: create PO as net amount (exclusive of VAT) and add VAT as separate line item Tax code "ID-PPN-11". Ensure invoice matches PO number and invoice includes Faktur Pajak reference.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days net. Banking details accepted as provided.
- Attachments: move vendor NPWP and sample e-Faktur to vendor folder in Drive and link to SAP vendor master (I will upload).

Rafael — tagging you in case Finance wants to map GL for freight/third-party logistics.

Mina Haddad
Accounts Payable Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: npwp_certificate.pdf, efaktur_sample.xml
